column1: # Conversions this tree performs with no cvt instruction, for
# cvtroll.awk -v magic=. A magic-number add rounds a float to an
# integer and the integer is read out of the mantissa, so an
# instruction count scores the conversion 0 while a machine with no FPU
# pays a full soft-float add for it (q8_round's own header: 48 ARM
# instructions).
#   LEAF<TAB>function<TAB>converts per call
#   LINE<TAB>file<TAB>line<TAB>converts per execution
# Found by grepping the magic constant 12582912.0f (1.5*2^23): three
# sites, one of them q8_round itself.
# THE TWO LINE KEYS ARE LINE NUMBERS and go stale exactly the way
# linemap.tsv's do, silently and downward: a missed row is work that
# reports as zero, not as an error. Re-grep 12582912.0f before trusting
# a measurement. Both were stale as recorded (333/448, from 0283fa0);
# 84adffc moved q8_round into ops_quant.h and the two lz_exp floors to
# 292/407, where they are at 3f796fd. q8_round itself stays a LEAF row
# rather than an ops_quant.h LINE row - the LEAF form charges it to the
# caller, and having both would count it twice.
LEAF
LINE
LINE
